membershipDescription: Clients introduced by Clean Up System receive a complimentary membership to Direct Route (valued at £200.00 + Vat) plus zero cost debt recovery on all debts up to £3,000 with a subsidised cost of just 2% commission, payable only upon a successful recovery being effected. Additionally Clean Up System introduced clients receive 100 complimentary units to AccountAssyst entitling them to up to 16 free credit reports or use of account opening services and automated online credit control chasing instead.
mailText:
Dear [[ApplicantName]] 

Re: Invitation to activate your Clean Up System Zero Cost Debt Collection benefit - [[ApplicantCompany]]  

We write further to our recent conversation concerning our debt collection services. 

As an introduced client of Clean Up System we are pleased to confirm your entitlement to a complimentary registration with Direct Route (usual cost £200.00 + Vat).   

We note that you may require assistance with several overdue customers annually. Additionally you have advised that when outsourcing debt you ordinarily would not have any intention of future dealings with the customer.

Having considered the position therefore we are pleased to advise that you qualify for, and indeed we would recommend, our Fairway Gold service as being the most appropriate for your needs. 

Fairway Gold is a renowned, established and proven Credit Management Solution, available exclusively through Direct Route.

As a Fairway Gold Member you will receive zero cost debt recovery on all debts up to £3000 and subsidised 2% recovery commission on all collected debts of greater value. 

If you have received this email then great news...you have already been pre-qualified for Fairway Gold Membership. This email is your formal invitation to join. 

To accept the invitation simply follow this link [[MembershipFormLink]] to complete your Fairway Gold Membership Application Form.  
 
Additionally you may wish to note that you are entitled to a complimentary benefit package, courtesy of Clean Up System, from our renowned sister company AccountAssyst. This enables you to obtain a number of free credit reports, open new customer accounts and operate internal credit control chasing amongst other things. Simply visit https://cleanupsystem.accountassyst.com/sales/ and Join Now to activate your free benefit.    

What Happens Next?
Once we receive your Membership Application Form  [[MembershipFormLink]] we will quickly process your application and activate your Fairway Gold Membership. You will also receive details of how to instruct us to begin collecting overdue monies from any late paying customers, effective immediately.        

Kindly note that all debt instructions submitted are subject to our  [[TermsConditions]].
 
We very much look forward to hearing from you further.
acceptanceText:
Dear [[ApplicantName]] 

We are pleased to advise that your complimentary Fairway Gold Membership with Direct Route Collections has now been approved (usual cost £200.00 + Vat). This joining benefit is provided to you at no cost courtesy of your relationship with Clean Up System.   

You may now begin instructing us to collect debts with immediate effect.

Please send copy invoices or statements for all customers that you would like chasing to newdebts@directroute.co.uk.

TOP TIP - Experience shows that collection performance times are markedly improved if you are able to provide contact name(s), telephone numbers and email addresses for any accounts you would like us to chase.

As a Direct Route Fairway Gold Member you receive zero cost debt collection on debts up to £3,000. For greater value debts you pay just 2% + Vat commission, which is chargeable only upon successful recovery (no collection no commission charge). In summary your debt recovery cost is paid for in full by your customer if less than £3,000 or if your debt is for more than that the collection cost is subsidised by late payment fees recovered from your customer in addition to your overdue account.

Kindly note that all debt instructions received are subject to our [[TermsConditions]]. 

We very much look forward to receiving your first instructions and also to successfully recovering monies on your behalf for many years to come.

A subsidised 2% recovery fee on debts of £3,000.00 or more

To activate your trial, please complete the short online application using the link below:

[[MembershipFormLink]]

Once your application has been processed, we will send full details on how to refer debts directly to us under the trial arrangement.

acceptanceText:
Dear [[ApplicantName]] 

We are pleased to confirm that your Fairway Gold Membership Trial has been approved, and you may now begin instructing us to collect debts with immediate effect.

Please send copy invoices or statements for any customers you would like us to pursue to:

newdebts@directroute.co.uk 

Top Tip:

Collection performance improves significantly when you can provide additional details such as contact names, telephone numbers, and email addresses for the accounts you would like us to chase.

As a Direct Route Fairway Gold Member, you benefit from:

Zero-cost debt recovery on debts up to £3,000.00.

Just 2% + VAT commission on debts over £3,000.00, which is payable only upon successful recovery (no collection, no commission).

In summary:

If your debt is below £3,000.00, the recovery cost is covered in full by your customer.

If above £3,000.00, your cost is largely subsidised through late payment fees recovered from the debtor alongside your overdue amount.

Please note that all debt instructions are subject to our [[TermsConditions]].

We look forward to receiving your first instructions and to successfully recovering outstanding monies on your behalf - now and in the years ahead.
